name: image-template-dialogue-portrait-expression-sheet
title: Dialogue Portrait Expression Sheet
description: A 3x3 expression sheet of one character as a dialogue portrait bust: neutral, happy, laughing, sad, angry, surprised, embarrassed, determined and scared, all with identical framing, eye line and outfit on a flat background so they swap cleanly in a dialogue box. Slots for character, style and expressions.

description_i18n.en: A 3x3 expression sheet of one character as a dialogue portrait bust: neutral, happy, laughing, sad, angry, surprised, embarrassed, determined and scared, all with identical framing, eye line and outfit on a flat background so they swap cleanly in a dialogue box. Slots for character, style and expressions.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 生成同一角色的 3x3 对话立绘表情差分表：平静、开心、大笑、难过、生气、惊讶、害羞、坚定和害怕，所有格子取景、视线高度与服装完全一致，背景为纯色，可在对话框中无缝切换。可调整角色、画风与表情列表。

query.en:
A character expression sheet for in-game dialogue portraits: the same character drawn {argument name="count" default="9 times in a 3x3 grid"}, one expression per cell.

Character: {argument name="character" default="a sharp-tongued young engineer with short copper hair, a soot smudge on one cheek, round goggles pushed up on her head and a worn canvas work jacket"}.
Art style: {argument name="art_style" default="clean anime-inspired 2D illustration with crisp line art and two-tone cel shading"}.
Expressions, in reading order: {argument name="expressions" default="neutral, happy, laughing, sad, angry, surprised, embarrassed, determined, scared"}.

# Consistency rules (critical)
- Bust framing from mid-chest up, facing about three-quarters toward the viewer's left (so the portrait can sit on the left of a dialogue box).
- Identical head size, eye line, shoulder line and position in every cell; only the face, eyebrows, mouth, small head tilt and hand gestures near the face change.
- Identical outfit, hair, accessories and colours in every cell; no costume drift.
- Every cell has the same flat background colour, {argument name="background" default="pale warm grey"}, so portraits can be cut out cleanly. Even gutters between cells, no frames or borders.

# Expression craft
- Exaggerate readable cues: eyebrow shape, eye openness and mouth shape do most of the work, plus small extras such as a sweat drop, a blush or tears where they fit.
- Each emotion must be distinguishable when the portrait is shown at 160 pixels tall.

# Lighting and palette
- Soft key light from the upper left, the same in every cell.
- Palette: {argument name="palette" default="copper, olive canvas and cream with teal goggle lenses"}.

# Avoid
Text, speech bubbles, names, cell labels, changing camera angles, changing clothing or hairstyle, cropped heads, extra fingers, watermarks, and resemblance to existing franchise characters.
